test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rythu Bandhu scheme is the scheme of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Relieving the Farmers **from the **debt burden **and **not allowing **them to **fall into the debt trap again**.
 
• **Rythu Bandhu **Scheme is **proposed **by the **Government of Telangana.**
 
• It **provides Investment Support **to **Agriculture **and **Horticulture crops**.
 
• It gives **a grant of Rs. 5,000/- per acre per farmer each season **for the **purchase of inputs like Seeds**.
 
• The **“Agriculture Investment Support Scheme” **(Rythu Bandhu), the first **cash transfer scheme **for **farmers**, **was introduced by the Telangana State government **in **2018-19**. **Rythu Bandhu **literally means **'Friend of Farmer'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Scheme in Telangana**:

 
 
• Pradhan Mantri Gramin Awaas Yojana.
 
• Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana.
 
• Aasara pensions.
 
• Arogya Lakshmi.
 
• Haritha Haram.
 
• KCR Kit.
 
• Mission Kakathiya.
